title: Sycophancy as Belief Incoherence: Bayesian Audit of How Pressure Shifts LLM Probabilities

original_idea.body:
# Bayesian Audit of Sycophancy

Re-elicit probabilities after user agreement/disagreement/neutral; measure unjustified shift vs zero-shift Bayesian ideal.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: sycophancy undermines oversight/belief-elicitation, but the link to catastrophic risk is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inference-only probability re-elicitation under pressure; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused Bayesian-deviation metric; several conditions/claim types.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models, inference-only, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: BASIL already frames sycophancy as Bayesian-update deviation; largely addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: BASIL already operationalizes sycophancy as Bayesian deviation.
